verdict.rationale: Reflect's only first-party link to external LLMs is a built-in toggle between GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet inside its own AI palette. External tools can reach Reflect only through a limited OAuth REST API and Zapier, which can append notes and list links. The docs say note contents cannot be served via the API because of end-to-end encryption, so outside AI tools cannot read your notes, and a community user stresses there is no plugin system. Missing for 10: first-party connectors that let external AI tools read and query notes (e.g. an MCP server or AI-tool integrations), an AI plugin ecosystem, read access to note content via the API, llms.txt or other AI-oriented docs.
